data.long_meaning: The one who keeps away evil, a protector, a guardian, a defender. The name Qareen carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qareen usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Qareen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qareen total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
data.cultural_impact: The name Qareen is mentioned in the Quran and hadiths, implying its significance in Islamic culture. It is believed that every person has a protective guardian known as a Qareen. This belief adds to the psychological aspect of an individual's faith, giving people a sense of being protected and watched over by a divine entity.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic belief, the Qareen is considered to be a spiritual being that is responsible for the spiritual well-being of humans. It is believed that the Qareen tries to guide human beings towards righteousness and keeps them away from sin and the devil. The spiritual significance of the name Qareen is a reminder that every individual is not alone in their spiritual journey and is constantly being guided and watched over by a higher power.
